family_decision: Do not project malformed observed stay amounts into shared nightly-price and budget comparisons.
hypothesis: Existing positive finite safe-rounded-cent validation rejects sub-cent USD/GBP stay amounts before derived nightly output.
result: REJECT hypothesis: synthetic stay_amount0.001USD validated with no errors and projected nightly_average0. Three of six new regression tests failed before repair; all must pass after repair.

synthetic_controls.retained_valid_rounding: Positive cent-precision stay amounts keep existing rounded nightly equivalents. A synthetic valid one-cent five-night stay can still round to zero per night; this change does not ban all zero rounded equivalents or assert real availability.

confidence: High reproducible validation-boundary evidence; no observed real malformed price or user harm, booking, final affordability, satisfaction or SEO outcome established.
lesson: A positive raw amount and a safe rounded-cent value do not establish currency-cent precision. Reject malformed observations before rounding, including plans later excluded from output.
falsification_trigger: A valid maintained cent amount or unchanged output regresses; a new supported currency/unit requires a separately evidenced minor-unit contract.
